autoHeight.description: Give waypoints without a height, or with heightSource auto, the lowest height that keeps their legs in the corridor (route.prepare); manual heights are never changed

stepM.description: Spacing of the corridor samples along the route

clearanceM.description: Lowest height above the ground and obstacles the floor allows

takeoffM.description: Within this distance of the pilot the floor rises from the ground to the full clearance, and a plan under it is not warned about: the climb-out and the landing

ceilingAglM.description: Highest height above ground: the corridor's ceiling, e.g. the legal limit

linkFloor.description: Raise the floor to where the link's Fresnel clearance holds; off = terrain clearance only

fresnelFraction.description: Share of the first Fresnel zone radius that must be clear for the link floor

maxAglM.description: Highest height searched for the link floor

climbAssist.description: Compare the plan's climb with the energy-optimal profile and simpler strategies, each offered as a fix (data.climb)

climbRateMps.description: Highest climb rate past the take-off zone; 0 = the drone's measured climb rate, else 3 m/s

descentRateMps.description: Highest descent rate past the take-off zone

speedMps.description: Airspeed for climb gradients and flight time; 0 = the drone's cruise airspeed, else 15 m/s

heightStepM.description: Height grid of the energy-optimal search

fitToleranceM.description: How far the waypoints of a strategy's fix may stray from its profile
